$comment: Bench-only simulation of BMW's stock G20 Comfort cluster: our own drawings fitted to car photos. Written by tools/g20sim/build_manifest.py from the packages' manifest.part.json files; do not edit.

entries.notes: Roboto (SIL OFL 1.1, fonts/Roboto-OFL.txt), variable wdth 75-100 / wght 100-900, subset Latin+Cyrillic; loaded by G20C.init(base) as 'G20Roboto'

Opaque panel background: pure black (the owner's colour rule, polish C). The photo's blue-grey there (still fitted, as a node grid, to measure the soft layers against) is the LCD's lit-up black, the cabin light and the camera's haze; half resolution.

Our own seeded street layout (never BMW's data) inside map.region with the measured edge fade; background, road colours and widths per look from 08 (night) and 09 (day). Streets drift down at speed (m/s) * px_per_m (weak: 1 px/m). Drawn under B's semi-transparent dial faces.
Red chevron at map.position_arrow (fixed; the streets move).

Semi-transparent black veil over map.region where the dial faces overlap the map (left and right ends). Alpha = 1 - road contrast(x) / plateau, fitted as two logistic ramps [1.0, 598.13, 53.46, 1.0, 1320.77, 53.46]. Only the roads' attenuation is in it; the map's own darker background fade at its ends is NOT (D's map). Drop or tune it when calibrating with D's map.

Pointer-glow zone (distance < 100 px to the needle, y > 415) masked and continued from the neighbours along the band (weak there).

Opaque grey 'wing' face between the band line and the inner edge E, with E's bevel. The lower part (y > 415) is under the pointer glow in every photo: continued from above (weak). Day: the night face times one gain (the day photos show the sky's reflection mid-face).

Mirror of the fuel mini. Seen at the notch (08/09, warm) and the cold end (14, COLD): within 1.9 px. The temperature range 70..150 degC is a guess (no numerals on the scale).
